dbBackup.title: Full backup (off-site)
dbBackup.desc: Whenever data changes, the whole database is dumped, encrypted, and shipped to Cloudflare R2 automatically (bursts of changes coalesce into one run per hour, and the weekly Sunday backup still runs). Run a backup now, download a stored one, or restore from here.
dbBackup.dispatched: Backup started (check progress in GitHub Actions)
dbBackup.restoreWarning: Restoring replaces ALL current data (members, attendance, settings, everything) with the backup's snapshot. This cannot be undone — make sure you have a recent backup before continuing.
dbBackup.privateKeyHint: Never stored — used only for this one restore request.

admin.dbBackupCurrentDesc: Whenever data changes, the full database is automatically encrypted and overwrites the one current backup in Cloudflare R2 (bursts coalesce into one run per hour, and the weekly Sunday 5 PM Pittsburgh run still happens). Its size and completion time update live above.
admin.dbBackupCurrentDescAdult: The Adult Ministry backup runs completely separately from College & Young Adult. It fires only when Adult Ministry data (roster, attendance) changes, encrypting just that data over a single current backup in its own Cloudflare R2 location (bursts are coalesced to once an hour, and the Sunday 5 PM Pittsburgh run covers it too). Restoring here rolls back Adult Ministry data only — College & Young Adult data is untouched.
admin.dbBackupRestoreWarningAdult: Restoring replaces all current Adult Ministry data (roster, attendance, roles) with the backup's snapshot. College & Young Adult data and shared settings are not changed. This cannot be undone — make sure you have a recent backup before continuing.

members.statusHelp: For a move, a return to Korea, graduation … You can add several spans. Leave the end date empty (open-ended) and the member is hidden from the sheet, the members tab and the kiosk; with an end date the span just greys out on the sheet (귀국 · 이주 · 졸업 hide either way).

settings.semesterDatesDesc: The next {{count}} terms — two years' worth. Each term keeps its own start and end date.
settings.semesterRollNote: When a term ends it drops off this list and the next one is appended at the back. Finished terms keep their dates for the past-term attendance sheets.
settings.semesterDatesInvalid: Each semester must start before it ends, and semester ranges cannot overlap.
settings.summerModeAutoDesc: Turns itself on for the 여름학기 ({{start}}–{{end}}), merging 대학부·청년부 by 동산 while it runs. Change the semester dates above and this window follows.

settings.dongsanNamesDesc_adult: Add, rename, or remove cells. Cell names are fixed — they carry over from term to term.
settings.dongsanEmptyAfterTerm: The 동산 groups were cleared when the term ended. Add this term's 동산 for each 부서.
settings.dongsanEmptyAfterTerm_adult: No cells yet. Add your cell names.
settings.newMemberDongsanNamesDesc: Add, rename, or remove 동산 used only during newcomer education — separate from the regular 동산 list.
settings.dongsanLeadersDesc: Set the leader (동산지기) and sub-leaders (부동산지기) for each 동산. Shown as badges on member cards and the Today list.
settings.dongsanLeadersDesc_adult: Set the cell leader (셀장) and assistant leaders (부셀장) for each cell. Cell names are fixed; only the leaders change. Shown as badges on member cards and the Today list.
settings.groupColorsDesc: Accent colors for 대학부/청년부 — used on Today name icons, kiosk backgrounds, Members cards, and the Analytics group-comparison chart.
settings.cardScanLimitDesc: Today's remaining Gemini API calls for card recognition, refreshed every two seconds. The allowance is set automatically to the Gemini free-tier maximum (250 per day) and resets at Pittsburgh midnight.
